script:
-- ===================================================

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
    ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
elseif gethui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()

    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local ContentSigiloso = Instance.new("Frame")

ContentSigiloso.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 58)
ContentSigiloso.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local SigilosoTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

SigilosoTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

SigilosoTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- Texto blanco para contraste con azul
SigilosoTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
SigilosoTitle.TextSize = 15
SigilosoTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SigilosoTitle.Parent = ContentSigiloso

-- Cuadros apilados en Azul
local function CreateFunctionButton(text, yPos, defaultState, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 42)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yPos)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 130) -- Azul de cuadro
    Btn.Text = text
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.TextSize = 15
    Btn.Parent = ContentSigiloso

    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    BtnCorner.Parent = Btn

    local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    BtnStroke.Thickness = 2
    BtnStroke.Parent = Btn

    local state = defaultState
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 130)
        callback(state)
    end)
end

CreateFunctionButton("Girar Cuerpo (Auto Pass)", 38, false, function(active)
    AutoTargetEnabled = active
end)

CreateFunctionButton("Hitbox Frontal (12 studs)", 90, false, function(active)
    HitboxFrontEnabled = active
end)

CreateFunctionButton("Velocidad (18.5)", 142, false, function(active)
    SpeedEnabled = active
end)

-- CONTENEDOR FUNCIONES OBIAS
local ContentObias = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentObias.Name = "ContentObias"

ContentObias.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 58)
ContentObias.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentObias.Visible = false
ContentObias.Parent = MainFrame

local ObiasTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
ObiasTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 30)
ObiasTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
ObiasTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ObiasTitle.Text = "aquí va el apartado que se selecciono"
ObiasTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ObiasTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
ObiasTitle.TextSize = 15
ObiasTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
ObiasTitle.Parent = ContentObias

-- Botón activar la función chicle (Azul)
local ChicleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ChicleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 55)
ChicleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 38)
ChicleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 130) -- Azul de cuadro
ChicleBtn.Text = "activar la función chicle"
ChicleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ChicleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ChicleBtn.TextSize = 18
ChicleBtn.Parent = ContentObias

local ChicleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ChicleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
ChicleCorner.Parent = ChicleBtn

local ChicleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ChicleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
ChicleStroke.Thickness = 2
ChicleStroke.Parent = ChicleBtn

ChicleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    FocusChicleEnabled = not FocusChicleEnabled
    ChicleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = FocusChicleEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 130)
end)

-- Contenedor Lista de Jugadores (Azul)
local ListFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
ListFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 235, 0, 38)
ListFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 130) -- Azul de cuadro
ListFrame.Parent = ContentObias

local ListCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ListCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
ListCorner.Parent = ListFrame

local ListStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ListStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
ListStroke.Thickness = 2
ListStroke.Parent = ListFrame

local ListTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
ListTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
ListTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 5)
ListTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ListTitle.Text = "lista de jugadores"
ListTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ListTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ListTitle.TextSize = 20
ListTitle.Parent = ListFrame

local PlayerScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
PlayerScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -45)
PlayerScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38)
PlayerScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PlayerScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
PlayerScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
PlayerScroll.Parent = ListFrame

local PlayerLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
PlayerLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
PlayerLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
PlayerLayout.Parent = PlayerScroll

-- Función para actualizar lista
local function RefreshPlayerList()
    for _, child in pairs(PlayerScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local count = 0
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            count = count + 1
            local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 28)
            Btn.BackgroundColor3 = (SelectedFocusPlayer == plr) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(25, 55, 95)
            Btn.Text = plr.DisplayName .. " (@" .. plr.Name .. ")"
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
            Btn.TextSize = 14
            Btn.Parent = PlayerScroll

            local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            Corner.Parent = Btn

            local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            Stroke.Thickness = 1
            Stroke.Parent = Btn

            Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if SelectedFocusPlayer == plr then
                    SelectedFocusPlayer = nil
                else
                    SelectedFocusPlayer = plr
                end
                RefreshPlayerList()
            end)
        end
    end

    PlayerScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 34)
end

RefreshPlayerList()
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(RefreshPlayerList)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(RefreshPlayerList)

-- ===============================================
-- 🔄 LÓGICA DE MINIMIZAR / NAVEGACIÓN Y FUNCIONES
-- ===============================================

    MainFrame.Visible = false
    FloatingIcon.Visible = true
end)

FloatingIcon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    FloatingIcon.Visible = false
    MainFrame.Visible = true
end)

TabSigiloso.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ContentSigiloso.Visible = true
    ContentObias.Visible = false
    TabSigiloso.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabObias.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 85, 100)
end)

TabObias.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ContentSigiloso.Visible = false
    ContentObias.Visible = true
    TabObias.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabSigiloso.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 85, 100)
end)

local function HasBomb()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return false end

    for _, tool in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower():find("bomb") or tool.Name:lower():find("bomba") or tool.Name:lower():find("time")) then
            return true
        end
    end

    if char:FindFirstChild("Bomb") or char:FindFirstChild("Bomba") then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function ResetTargetHitbox()
    if CurrentHitboxTarget then
        if CurrentHitboxTarget.Character and CurrentHitboxTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = CurrentHitboxTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            hrp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            hrp.Transparency = 1
            hrp.CanCollide = false
        end
        CurrentHitboxTarget = nil
    end
end

local function GetFrontPlayer()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    local myHRP = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local myLook = myHRP.CFrame.LookVector
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = HitboxFrontDistance

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local targetHRP = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local dir = (targetHRP.Position - myHRP.Position)
                local dist = dir.Magnitude

                if dist <= HitboxFrontDistance then
                    local dot = myLook:Dot(dir.Unit)
                    if dot > 0.4 then 
                        if dist < shortest then
                            shortest = dist
                            closest = player
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

local function GetClosestPlayer(maxDist)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    local myPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = maxDist

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortest then
                    shortest = dist
                    closest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then 
        ResetTargetHitbox()
        return 
    end

    if SpeedEnabled then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = TargetSpeed
    end

    local iHaveBomb = HasBomb()

    if HadBombLastFrame and not iHaveBomb then
        ResetTargetHitbox()
    end
    HadBombLastFrame = iHaveBomb

    if AutoTargetEnabled and iHaveBomb then
        local target = GetClosestPlayer(TargetDistance)
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local myHRP = char.HumanoidRootPart
            local targetPos = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            local lookAtPos = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, myHRP.Position.Y, targetPos.Z)
            myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHRP.Position, lookAtPos)
        end
    end

    if FocusChicleEnabled and iHaveBomb and SelectedFocusPlayer then
        if SelectedFocusPlayer.Character and SelectedFocusPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and SelectedFocusPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and SelectedFocusPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            if CurrentHitboxTarget and CurrentHitboxTarget ~= SelectedFocusPlayer then
                ResetTargetHitbox()
            end

            CurrentHitboxTarget = SelectedFocusPlayer
            local targetHRP = SelectedFocusPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local myHRP = char.HumanoidRootPart

            targetHRP.Size = Vector3.new(40, 40, 40)
            targetHRP.Transparency = 1
            targetHRP.CanCollide = false

            myHRP.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)
            return
        end
    end

    if HitboxFrontEnabled and iHaveBomb then
        local frontTarget = GetFrontPlayer()
        
        if frontTarget then
            if CurrentHitboxTarget and CurrentHitboxTarget ~= frontTarget then
                ResetTargetHitbox()
            end

            CurrentHitboxTarget = frontTarget
            local hrp = frontTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                hrp.Size = Vector3.new(HitboxWidth, HitboxHeight, HitboxFrontDistance)
                hrp.Transparency = 1
                hrp.CanCollide = false
            end
        else
            ResetTargetHitbox()
        end
    else
        if not FocusChicleEnabled or not iHaveBomb then
            ResetTargetHitbox()
        end
    end
end)
features: auto pass the pump bubble mode and much more
